subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**attributed**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is explaining that health benefits are associated with or due to antioxidants.
 
• The word "attributed" means to regard something as being caused by or linked to a particular source, which fits the context of the sentence.
 
• "Negative" would imply an adverse effect, which is not suitable here.
 
• "Parallel" and "similar" do not convey the idea of causation or linking health benefits to antioxidants.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

Complete Passage: *(1) Numerous health benefits, including protection from cardiovascular disease and cancer, have been (2) attributed__ to antioxidants; however, according to dietitian Vinson, these benefits depend on how well antioxidants are absorbed and (3) ______ by the body. According to the study, coffee has more antioxidant power than other well-known foods and drinks, like tea, milk, chocolate, and cranberries. Dates had the highest antioxidants per serving out of all the foods and drinks (4) ______, but because dates are not consumed to the same extent as coffee, the latter comes out on (5) ______, according to Vinson.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Negative: Suggests an adverse effect, which is not suitable in the context of health benefits.
 
• Parallel: Means running alongside, which does not fit the context of attributing benefits to a cause.
 
• Similar: Indicates likeness, which does not convey the idea of causation or linking benefits to antioxidants.
